plugin.description: A countdown timer on a key, with a progress ring around the remaining time.

Countdown.description: Counts down from a set duration and draws the remaining time plus a progress ring on the key. Pressing starts it, pressing again pauses and resumes, holding resets it. On a dial, turning changes the duration by a second per step. It can run a command when it reaches zero and write the remaining time into a file for OBS.

duration.description: How long the countdown runs, in seconds.

command.description: Shell command to run once the countdown reaches zero. Empty runs nothing.

output_enabled.description: Write the remaining time into a text file, so OBS or another program can show it.

output_file.description: The file to write the remaining time into. Only used with output_enabled.

zero_text.description: What to write into the file once the countdown is finished. Only affects the file, not the key.
